sources.title: Arie Lawrence Hersh - Cuyahoga naturalization card
sources.description: Original card image inspected. Arie Lawrence Hersh, birth entry 6/1/25, age 36, naturalized August 11, 1961 in U.S. District Court, recorded August 23. Office no. 201619; certificate no. 8195469. Remarks "Name changed as part of nat. proc." and a handwritten line of his own names under a misleading wife-name label: ARIE - LARRY - HERSHKOVITZ. It is not a spouse entry. Origin line at right unresolved. Historical residential address withheld from public copy.

sources.title: Szymon Warszavski - Social Security NUMIDENT index
sources.description: Indexed NUMIDENT extraction displayed on authenticated FamilySearch page; no underlying SS-5 image available. Gives birth April 1, 1918 in Warsaw, Poland; June 1963 social program application; Cleveland; death July 18, 1995; parents indexed as Joseph Warszavski and Rochel Goldberg. Same death date as original 1995 obituary supports identity. Parent spellings and birth details require original SS-5 or other independent record.

sources.title: Elka Kagan Zelkind - Social Security NUMIDENT index
sources.description: Authenticated indexed page screenshot inspected; no original SS-5 image. Elka Kagan Zelkind (alias Elka Kagan Kaga), birth November 12, 1913 in indexed "Bubruysk, Soviet Union" (the Soviet Union label is anachronistic for 1913), April 29, 1981 application, Cleveland, death March 14, 2005. Indexed parents Isac Kaga and Tsilya Gershon. Ohio death index gives paternal surname Kogan; Kaga/Kagan/Kogan are unverified variants, not merged into a legal maiden name.

sources.title: Zion Memorial Park burial register - Warszawski and Zelkind surname results
sources.publisher: Zion Memorial Park, Bedford Heights, Ohio
sources.description: Cemetery-operated last-name search inspected September 25, 2026. Warszawski: BERTHA interred Nov 29, 2016, Z6 row 1 grave 58. Zelkind: ELKA interred March 16, 2005, Z6 row 4 grave 110; MORDUKH interred Sept 25, 1996, Z6 row 6 grave 110; GAIL interred Feb 1, 2013, Z6 row 4 grave 111. Interment dates, not death dates; cemetery cautions typos/human error. Cemetery alone does not prove Gail’s kinship; Mordukh’s separate 1996 original notice identifies her as his daughter. Hersh search: ILEEN interred May 24, 2009, Z3 row 1 grave 34; LAWRENCE interred Jan 3, 2012, Z3 row 1 grave 35; duplicate Jan 5 RESERVE line at same grave is not a separate burial.

sources.title: Berta Warszawski headstone, Zion Memorial Park

Hebrew inscription not fully transcribed from low-resolution image. Stone civil date conflicts with family yahrtzeit 26 Cheshvan (corresponding to Nov 27 daytime in 5777); keep both and seek death record or clearer stone photo.

sources.title: Mordukh Zelkind death notice, The Plain Dealer, Sept. 25, 1996, p. B8
sources.publisher: The Plain Dealer via Cleveland Public Library News Index
sources.description: Original newspaper clipping inspected. Calls Mordukh husband of Elka (nee Kogen), father of Bertha Warshawsky, Gail Zelkind, Maria Komisarchik and Celya Elin. Warshawsky is the notice spelling, not a replacement for the family Warszawski spelling. Compare 1997 CJN Berta/Gala/Tzila/Masha, not all independently reconciled.

research_leads.text: COLlive, Anash.org, CrownHeights.info and ChabadInfo birth notices ('nee Warszawski') are the best place to find the grandchildren.
Shoshy is gathering more family details - birthdays, kids and grandparents will be added as they come in.

Joe's funeral was handled by Berkowitz-Kumin-Bookatz Memorial Chapel in Cleveland Heights (Feb 2017); its obituary or the Cleveland Jewish News notice from that week should name his parents and survivors.
Joe’s full obituary: Cleveland Jewish News digital archive, late-February 2017 issues. Library-card or paid access required.
A different Shaina Hirsch died in 2020; her listed children do not include Lori. Do not merge her with Shaina Yuda "Gabby".
Partial Houston name match for Ilana Marinovsky does not establish identity or marriage.

GAIL Zelkind appears on a stone dated July 25, 1942 - Feb 28, 2013, while Zion register lists Feb 1, 2013 interment, an impossible sequence unless one record errs. She is buried beside Elka; compare with Gala from 1997 CJN but do not merge on name/proximity.

Obtain Ileen Hersh’s May 2009 death/funeral notice or gravestone photo. Adjacent Zion interment May 24, 2009 plus family 28 Iyar is a strong identity/year match; May 22 remains an indexed, unverified death date.
Resolve Elka’s likely stone year 1914 against indexed NUMIDENT November 12, 1913 and clarify stone surname/portrait; obtain original SS-5, birth record or higher-resolution stone photo.

Zvi Warszawski of Montreal (1926-1976) is not documented as a member of Shoshy’s Cleveland Warszawski line. Seek spouse/children and immigration evidence before any kinship edge; Joe’s father is Szyman/Sam per 1986 notice and 1995 obituary.
New York headstones for Benjamin and Wolf Zelkind lack a proven connection to Cleveland Mordechi, Elka and Berta. Keep unlinked until a direct relationship record is found.
Obit names a Warszawski granddaughter 'Moriah' - possibly the family list's 'Maimi'? Unconfirmed; keep marked as inference.
Victor (d.1978) and Pearl (d.1973) Garson in adjacent plots may be Ileen's parents; Leo and Ida Garson unlinked. All inferences pending records.
Rabbi Meyer (d.1973) and Esther (d.1960) Kogen at Mt. Olive, Solon - possible Kogen relatives of Elka; unlinked pending records.
Ester Warshofsky (d.1954) unlinked; possible Warszawski variant.

Ileen (d.2009) and Larry Hersh remain absent from JOWBR Ohio despite re-confirmed Zion Memorial Park register entries (Z3-1-34 interred 05/24/2009; Z3-1-35 interred 01/03/2012), and Joe Warszawski (d. Feb 18 2017) is absent from the cemetery's OWN online register though his stone is photographed there. JOWBR correction or cemetery office follow-up may close the indexing gaps.

European leads: Rabbi Zev Wolf Zelkind of Zembin; Dynya + Leyzer Zelkind, Babruysk; Edya + Rakhil Zelkind, Vitsyebsk; Juda Warszawski (1900-1942), Cmentarz Palmiry (likely Holocaust victim); Jehoszua Krenik Warszawski, Kutno; four Warszawski-variant burials at Bagnowka Cemetery, Bialystok; Varshovski family, Vilkaviskis.

KOGEN Belarus sweep (296 phonetic matches, JewishGen): strongest lead is the large KOGEN household of Yankel' Vul'f at PARICHI, Bobruisk uyezd (July 1834 revision) - same uyezd as the Babruysk Zelkind line; INFERENCE only, unlinked. Also a Gomel birth cluster (Isaak 1902, Moisey 1908, Khaim 1915, Bassheva 1916), Kletsk 1834 households, Minsk/Gomel/Mogilev marriages, and Pinsk Ghetto + Soviet Extraordinary Commission Holocaust records. Yizkor necrology and JOWBR Russia pulls deferred.

GARSON France sweep (283 phonetic matches): only exact-spelling record is Aron GARSON x Caroline LEVY, Metz 1865; the phonetic cluster sits in the Alsace-Lorraine (Metz/Strasbourg) corridor - consistent with the French-origin family knowledge but NO proven link to Ileen's line. Deportation records: Fanny/Marcelle Nordon nee Gerson (d. Auschwitz 1943) and Rachel Yung nee Gerson (d. Auschwitz 1944) - unlinked.

HERSH Czechoslovakia: Subcarpathia datasets are huge (7,823 births); a targeted search for Arie Hersh(kowitz) b. 1 Jun 1925 plus Yad Vashem is planned. The name-change-from-Hershkovitz reading remains INFERENCE.
